title: ‘Dancing with the Stars Front Row’: Ciara Miller, Tyler Cameron, Bruno Tonioli, and More
summary: Ciara Miller, Maura Higgins, Tyler Cameron, Sharna Burgess, Bruno, Alfonso, Mark Ballas and more talk Dancing with the Stars on SiriusXM Radio Andy.
body_markdown:
Ahead of the premiere of season 35, *Dancing with the Stars* cast members, professional partners, judge Bruno Tonioli, and host Alfonso Ribeiro join[the Smith Sisters](https://www.siriusxm.com/blog/tag/smith-sisters-live) and a live audience for an exclusive *Dancing with the Stars Front Row* in the SiriusXM LA Garage on[Radio Andy (Ch. 101)](https://www.siriusxm.com/blog/tag/radio-andy) .


[Radio Andy Andy & pop culture (explicit) Listen on the App Listen on the App](https://sxm.app.link/BlogTagPage-RadioAndy)


Starting Monday, September 14 at 9am ET, listen to the exclusive[Front Row](https://www.siriusxm.com/blog/tag/town-hall) special — featuring Bruno, Alfonso, Ciara Miller, Maura Higgins, Tyler Cameron, Sharna Burgess (Tyler’s Pro), Mark Ballas (Maura’s Pro), and Brandon Armstrong (Ciara’s Pro) discuss the new season of the show — on car radios and the[SiriusXM app](https://sxm.app.link/BlogTagPage-RadioAndy) .


Season 35 of *Dancing with the Stars* debuts with a two-night premiere on Tuesday, September 15 and Wednesday, September 16 at 8pm ET on ABC and Disney+.
